pages.title: Networks
pages.text: $(thing)Networks$()$(br2)Join every place to every other with as few links as possible and you have a tree; add one more and it has a loop, a second way round. Unlocks the Network Map.

$(thing)Insight$(): 90$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Graph Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Integer Ring.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): How many different trees N join n labelled junctions, each link joining two of them, with no loop? Write it.
